verdict.rationale: Letta exposes an Agent SDK and App Server API (OpenAI-compatible, ACP adapter) for creating/resuming agents and building custom clients, showing meaningful API-level access parity with some UI functions. However, many CLI/UI-specific features (e.g. /remember, /doctor, /fork, /btw, /pin, dreaming triggers) are documented only as slash-commands or desktop actions with no explicit evidence they're exposed as SDK/API calls, and the openapi.json spec is unreachable (404s), making it hard to verify full API/UI parity. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints/SDK methods mirroring every CLI slash-command (memory ops, forking, dreaming), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of full parity.
